purpose: Explain historical per-domain role counts and source headings without treating every role under an ESCO section as an ESCO occupation.
interpretation: The historical role_count and ESCO Roles heading are separate from the current cleaned role library.
A role can be present in a historical domain file and later be reallocated to a more specific domain without being deleted.
An ESCO label/code proves an ESCO occupational record; an ISCO group alone does not prove ESCO provenance.
O*NET, WEF and specialist-framework roles remain valid evidence when labelled with their actual source class.
Every historical row receives a final source disposition: current canonical, current reallocation, source record not in the current population, or verified ISCO group record.

Conduct complete physicals, provide treatment, and counsel patients. May, in some cases, prescribe medication. Must graduate from an accredited educational program for physician assistants.

resolution.basis: exact O*NET title or alternate title matched local O*NET taxonomy

onet_source_identity.title: Anesthesiologist Assistants
onet_source_identity.description: Assist anesthesiologists in the administration of anesthesia for surgical and non-surgical procedures. Monitor patient status and provide patient care during surgical treatment.

resolution.basis: exact O*NET title or alternate title matched local O*NET taxonomy

onet_source_identity.title: Radiation Therapists
onet_source_identity.description: Provide radiation therapy to patients as prescribed by a radiation oncologist according to established practices and standards. Duties may include reviewing prescription and diagnosis; acting as liaison with physician and supportive care personnel; preparing equipment, such as immobilization, treatment, and protection devices; and maintaining records, reports, and files. May assist in dosimetry procedures and tumor localization.

resolution.basis: current canonical record exists under a more specific domain or label

onet_source_identity.title: Acupuncturists
onet_source_identity.description: Diagnose, treat, and prevent disorders by stimulating specific acupuncture points within the body using acupuncture needles. May also use cups, nutritional supplements, therapeutic massage, acupressure, and other alternative health therapies.

resolution.basis: exact O*NET title or alternate title matched local O*NET taxonomy

onet_source_identity.title: Naturopathic Physicians
onet_source_identity.description: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent diseases using a system of practice that is based on the natural healing capacity of individuals. May use physiological, psychological or mechanical methods. May also use natural medicines, prescription or legend drugs, foods, herbs, or other natural remedies.

resolution.basis: exact O*NET title or alternate title matched local O*NET taxonomy

onet_source_identity.title: Surgical Technologists
onet_source_identity.description: Assist in operations, under the supervision of surgeons, registered nurses, or other surgical personnel. May help set up operating room, prepare and transport patients for surgery, adjust lights and equipment, pass instruments and other supplies to surgeons and surgeons' assistants, hold retractors, cut sutures, and help count sponges, needles, supplies, and instruments.

resolution.basis: exact O*NET title or alternate title matched local O*NET taxonomy

onet_source_identity.title: Ophthalmic Medical Technicians
onet_source_identity.description: Assist ophthalmologists by performing ophthalmic clinical functions. May administer eye exams, administer eye medications, and instruct the patient in care and use of corrective lenses.

resolution.basis: exact O*NET title or alternate title matched local O*NET taxonomy

onet_source_identity.title: Occupational Therapy Aides
onet_source_identity.description: Under close supervision of an occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant, perform only delegated, selected, or routine tasks in specific situations. These duties include preparing patient and treatment room.

onet_source_identity.title: Physical Therapist Aides

resolution.basis: exact O*NET title or alternate title matched local O*NET taxonomy

onet_source_identity.title: Recreation Workers

onet_source_identity.description: Administer and maintain libraries or collections of information, for public or private access through reference or borrowing.
